summary: The diff implements all four requirements. REQ-1 (badge progress in Profile tab) is addressed via ProfileBadges.tsx and badgeProgress.ts. REQ-2 (clickable leaderboard modals) is addressed via PlayerProfileModal.tsx and LeaderboardPage.tsx. REQ-3 (Games Played column) is addressed in LeaderboardPage.tsx. REQ-4 (paginated match history) is addressed in ProfileMatchHistory.tsx. All acceptance criteria appear to be met with minor caveats noted below.

missing_requirements.requirement: Loading state is shown while fetching additional records
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileMatchHistory.tsx shows a skeleton loading state only for the initial data load. Pagination is entirely client-side (slicing already-fetched data), so there is no per-page loading state when navigating between pages. The initial fetch does show a loading skeleton, which partially satisfies this AC.
